notes.title: I OFFERED YOU THE CROWN Release Celebration!
notes.notes: [p]Winter Twilight Productions is thrilled to release our second game, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3635280/I_Offered_You_the_Crown/"]I OFFERED YOU THE CROWN![/url] We're celebrating with our biggest discount ever on our first game, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2929180/We_Need_Space/"]WE NEED SPACE.[/url] Blast off on our comedy space adventure and rediscover your love of coffee ice cream you never knew you had. Thanks for playing![/p]
